name: TableQuest
summary:
Step up to the table in TableQuest, a virtual reality table tennis game built for Meta Quest.

Your controller becomes your paddle. Swing, spin and smash the ball with natural motion and realistic ball physics that respond to every stroke. Whether you are learning the basics or sharpening your reflexes, TableQuest brings the feel of real ping pong into your room.

Features:
- Realistic table tennis physics with spin, speed and bounce
- Natural paddle control using your Quest controller
